Evidence boundary

Clear about what exists.

The walkthrough explains Robotia Online’s intended interaction. It does not claim that future services are already operating.

Local evidence

  • Two scripted robots and deterministic state
  • Resource gathering and workshop construction
  • Recorded browser replay and robot inspection
  • Fixture dataset and recipe exchange
  • Local run and independent verification contracts

Product direction

  • Persistent shared worlds and recovery
  • Live participant inference through ARE
  • Validated AlchLang construction profiles
  • Agent-built experiments and policy comparison
  • Governed exchange, promotion, and hosting
Open questions

Inference adapters and budgets, admitted recipe profiles, KEP identity and key custody, dataset rights, promotion criteria, concurrency, recovery scale, and provider isolation remain decisions for their respective owners.

Victory condition

Build a world that remembers how progress happened.

Robotia Online turns autonomous work into shared history, reproducible evidence, and capabilities that can travel.
